findings.evidence: Protocol page https://gso-bench.github.io/ shows no release identifier for the board (no version tag, only '102 tasks' and changelog dates); leaderboard.json metadata has only last_updated. Thus maintainer publishes no release identifier, so version_status must be 'snapshot', not 'published', and version should be 'snapshot-2026-10-23'.
findings.repair: Set version_status to 'snapshot' and version to 'snapshot-2026-10-23' (or the date used for snapshot); optionally update version_guard to reflect snapshot identity.

uncertainties: I cannot recompute SHA-256 hashes; I rely on the provided owner-computed hashes. I also cannot execute transport or hash verification. The retrieval date 2026-10-23 is used as the snapshot date for the repair.
